g.text: Design pattern 2 — Observer (publish/subscribe domain events with callbacks)
An observer is a callback, not a class: EventHandler<E> is the
TypeScript function type (event: E) => void. SseHub registers
closures in its constructor; the composition root registers a
lambda for stop.arrived. No class implements an observer interface.
Problem solved: a shuttle update must reach many independent
receivers (hundreds of browsers, the waiting-request module)
without the tracking module knowing any of them. Each callback
runs inside try/catch; one failure cannot break the publisher.
subscribe() returns a function that unsubscribes.
